Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

The Samedi are a young bloodline, none older than roughly two centuries, cursed with grotesque, decaying flesh upon the Embrace that marks them as walking corpses. Believed by many to descend from the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.z724BOvqpVyxjr6o]{Giovanni} — with whom they share a deep-rooted enmity — the Samedi are drawn to mortuary work, death cultism, and mercenary contracts that pay well for their unique talents.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Obfuscate, Thanatosis

Advantage: Samedi can learn the Necromancy Discipline and its paths without a Giovanni instructor (paying the usual out-of-clan Experience costs), starting with the Sepulchre Path.

Disadvantage: Like the Nosferatu, Samedi are physically repulsive: Repugnant x3 (never removable), they cannot possess Alluring, Gorgeous or Seductive, and cannot initiate Social Challenges except intimidation.

Organization: Loosely tied by shared origin and an interest in death and the Underworld; many work independently as mercenaries or assassins for princes and bishops alike.
